title: BMMR: A Large-Scale Bilingual Multimodal Multi-Discipline Reasoning Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model reasoning accuracy across 8 high-level academic disciplines (e.g., STEM versus humanities) and 300 sub-fields to identify performance imbalances and subject-specific skews.
Comparing model evaluation scores on native Chinese versus English questions to assess cross-lingual capabilities and performance disparities between the two languages.
